# @mod-internal/ui design tokens and typography

CSS custom properties available once `mod.css` or `mod-core.css` is loaded, with their light-mode values, plus the typeface and the typography classes. Dark mode (`data-theme="dark"` on `<html>`) overrides many tokens, so reference the variable, never its value. Search for a prefix (`--mod-primary`, `--spacing`, `--radius`, `--color-error`, `--error-`, `--text-`) rather than reading everything.

## Contents

- [Typeface](#typeface)
- [Typography classes](#typography-classes)
- [Brand theme](#brand-theme) (`css/mod-theme.css`)
- [Semantic tokens](#semantic-tokens) (`css/tokens.css`)
- [Navigation tokens](#navigation-tokens) (`css/navigation-tokens.css`)
- [Base theme scales](#base-theme-scales) (`utilities/DGATheme.css`)

## Typeface

Font family 'Saudi MOD', shipped with the library (`styles/assets/fonts-mod/`) and loaded by both `mod.css` and `mod-core.css`. Use it through `font-family: var(--font-family-primary)` (body text and components) or `var(--font-family-text)`; never name the family or the files yourself. Pick a weight with the `--font-weight-*` tokens or a number from this table; every weight from 100 to 900 resolves to a real file, so there is no faux bold.

| `font-weight` | File | Style |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 100 200 | `SaudiMOD-Thin.otf` | normal |
| 300 | `SaudiMOD-Light.otf` | normal |
| 400 | `SaudiMOD-Regular.otf` | normal |
| 500 | `SaudiMOD-Medium.otf` | normal |
| 600 | `SaudiMOD-SemiBold.otf` | normal |
| 700 | `SaudiMOD-Bold.otf` | normal |
| 800 900 | `SaudiMOD-Heavy.otf` | normal |

The base theme's weight tokens are `--font-weight-light` (100), `--font-weight-regular` (400), `--font-weight-medium` (500), `--font-weight-semibold` (600) and `--font-weight-bold` (700).

## Typography classes

Ready-made text styles: `.<size>-<weight>`, for example `<h1 class="display-md-semibold">` or `<p class="text-sm-regular">`. They set the font size and weight in the brand typeface (the base theme's per-weight font families point at the Saudi MOD files). **They are in `mod.css` only.** `mod-core.css` keeps only `.text-md-semibold` and `.text-sm-regular` (used by components); with `mod-core.css`, style your own text with the tokens instead, for example `font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);`. Library components style their own text; use these classes for your own headings and copy.

| Classes | Weights | Font size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.display-2xl-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--display-2xl)` = 72px |
| `.display-xl-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--display-xl)` = 60px |
| `.display-lg-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--display-lg)` = 48px |
| `.display-md-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--display-md)` = 36px |
| `.display-sm-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--display-sm)` = 30px |
| `.display-xs-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--display-xs)` = 24px |
| `.text-xl-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--text-xl)` = 20px |
| `.text-lg-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--text-lg)` = 18px |
| `.text-md-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--text-md)` = 16px |
| `.text-sm-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--text-sm)` = 14px |
| `.text-xs-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--text-xs)` = 12px |
| `.text-s-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--text-s)` = 8px |
| `.text-2xl-*` | `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold` | `var(--text-2xl)` = 24px |
